steps.en: Clone the repo, sync the app environment, fill the tool API keys in .env
steps.zh: 克隆仓库、同步环境，在 .env 里填好工具 API key

steps.en: Serve a fine-tuned model on your own GPUs with SGLang or vLLM
steps.zh: 用 SGLang 或 vLLM 把微调模型托管到自己的 GPU 上

steps.en: Run a research task with a prebuilt agent config pointed at that server
steps.zh: 选预置 agent 配置，指向这个服务跑一个研究任务

steps.en: MiroFlow drives the loop: up to 300 model-chosen tool calls, context keeps only the last 5 tool results
steps.zh: MiroFlow 编排循环：模型自主最多300次工具调用，上下文留最近5条

steps.en: Serper search, Jina scrape and E2B sandbox answer each step; the final result ships with sources
steps.zh: 搜索（Serper）、抓取（Jina）、沙箱（E2B）逐条应答，答案带来源

value.en: Self-hosted deep research on open weights you can read, modify and extend — the agent loop is your code, not a black-box API
value.zh: 开权重的自托管深度研究：agent 循环是你读得到、改得动的代码，不是黑盒 API
